_comment: Approximate USD list prices per 1M tokens, keyed by 'provider:model'. EDIT THESE to match your contract - they are estimates for the profiler's cost view, not billing truth. cachedInputPerMTok applies to Anthropic prompt-cache reads. Unknown keys fall back to zero cost (shown as an estimate). The mock provider is 0 so offline runs cost nothing; set MOCK_PRICE_AS=provider:model to price mock tokens at a real model's rate for a realistic demo.
